people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He did valiantly, and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
translations.bsb: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of its plunderers.
translations.kjv: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
translations.asv: And he did valiantly, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that despoiled them.
